# port_scorecard_group (Data Source)

Use this data source to read an existing scorecard group by identifier.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) The identifier of the scorecard group to read.

### Read-Only

- `blueprints` (Set of String) Blueprint identifiers in shared-rules mode.
- `created_at` (String) The creation date of the scorecard group.
- `created_by` (String) The creator of the scorecard group.
- `filters` (Attributes Map) Optional filters per blueprint in shared-rules mode, keyed by blueprint identifier. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `levels` (Attributes List) The available levels of the scorecard group, shared by all members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--levels))
- `properties` (String) Additional `_scorecard` blueprint properties applied to every member scorecard in the group, as a JSON encoded string.
- `rules` (Attributes List) The rules applied to every blueprint in shared-rules mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `scorecards` (Attributes Map) Map of blueprint identifier to member scorecard filter/rules in per-blueprint mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scorecards))
- `title` (String) The title of the scorecard group (applied to all member scorecards).
- `updated_at` (String) The last update date of the scorecard group.
- `updated_by` (String) The last updater of the scorecard group.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Read-Only:

- `combinator` (String) The combinator of the query.
- `conditions` (List of String) The conditions of the query. Each condition object should be encoded to a string.


<a id="nestedatt--levels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `levels`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) The color of the level
- `title` (String) The title of the level

- `level` (String) The level of the rule
- `query` (Attributes) The query of the rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules--query))
- `title` (String) The title of the rule
